answer: The bridge schedule is applied in kernel and relic publishes each instalment. A payout is split thus 44% arrives at settlement and the rest over 11 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An attacker thus cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4300 identities would post 3416 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
